props.headline: Get clarity on *your next move.*
props.lede: A free 15-minute call with a Ripehouse specialist. We review your position, answer your key questions, and help you decide whether structured advisory makes sense for you.
props.promise: No pressure. If it's not the right step, we'll tell you.

steps.title: We review your position
steps.text: Where you are now: income, equity, goals and time horizon. Ten minutes of listening before any talking.

steps.title: You get straight answers
steps.text: Ask us anything — the market, our approach, the numbers behind our client outcomes. No jargon, no scripts.

steps.title: You decide the next step
steps.text: If structured advisory makes sense, we map what happens next. If it doesn't, we'll tell you honestly.

items.title: Homeowners with equity
items.text: You own a home or investment property with usable equity, and want it working harder toward your future.

items.title: Households earning $175k+
items.text: Strong income, less certainty it is converting into long-term wealth. We help you sequence the next move.

items.title: Time-poor professionals
items.text: You want research, strategy and execution handled by a team — not another spreadsheet to maintain.

items.title: Long-term wealth builders
items.text: You think in decades, not headlines. Legacy, choices and financial independence are the goal.

props.heading: Myles *White*
props.imageAlt: Myles White, Strategic Wealth Consultant at Ripehouse Advisory
paragraphs: Myles is a Strategic Wealth Consultant on the Ripehouse strategy team. He spends most of the call listening — your income, equity, goals and time horizon — then gives you straight answers on whether structured advisory is the right next step for you.
Every call runs on the data-driven method our founder Jacob Field has built since 2011 — the same research and strategy process behind more than $2B purchased for clients across Australia.

items.question: Is this a sales call?
items.answer: No. It's a diagnostic conversation. We spend most of it listening, and we'll tell you plainly if structured advisory isn't the right step for you.

items.question: What does the call cost?
items.answer: Nothing. The 15 minutes are free, and there's no obligation to go further afterwards.

items.question: Do I need to prepare anything?
items.answer: No documents needed. A rough sense of your income, equity and goals is enough — we'll guide the conversation from there.

items.question: What happens after the call?
items.answer: If it makes sense, the next step is a deeper wealth consultation. If it doesn't, you leave with honest clarity on your position — either way, you decide.

items.question: Who will I actually speak with?
items.answer: Myles White, a Strategic Wealth Consultant on our strategy team — not a call centre. The same team that runs our research and advisory process.
